description: This file defines an abstract class 'Table' representing a UI component for displaying and manipulating tabular data in a Java Swing application. It includes methods for rendering tables, handling user interaction, data management, and comparison features, tailored for an automotive ECU tuning application.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: An abstract Swing JPanel subclass that models a data table with features for rendering, editing, comparison, highlighting, and user interaction, tailored for automotive ECU tuning applications.

methods.name: drawTable
methods.description: Abstract method to render the table visually.

methods.name: populateTable
methods.description: Abstract method to populate table data from a byte array input.

methods.name: cursorUp
methods.description: Abstract method to move the cursor up within the table.

methods.name: cursorDown
methods.description: Abstract method to move the cursor down within the table.

methods.name: cursorLeft
methods.description: Abstract method to move the cursor left within the table.

methods.name: cursorRight
methods.description: Abstract method to move the cursor right within the table.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Abstract method to serialize table data into a byte array for file saving.

methods.name: horizontalInterpolate
methods.description: Abstract method to perform horizontal interpolation on table data.

methods.name: isLiveDataSupported
methods.description: Abstract method to indicate if live data updates are supported.

methods.name: isButtonSelected
methods.description: Abstract method to indicate if a related button or toggle in UI is selected.
